posts.text:
At Delaney Hall I met with a woman who was taken from her newborn baby, an American, who was not getting the proper medical care she needed.

This for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty is a moral stain on our community and nation.

Video

Instead of protecting Americans, Trump’s cruelty and chaos is allowing corporations to profit off of people’s pain.

We must close Delaney Hall.

Video

I am deeply disturbed and outraged by the rapid escalation overnight at Delaney Hall, especially with video emerging that appears to show an ICE agent striking a protester with a baton into what seemed to be a moving 18‑wheeler truck. On Wednesday, during my visit, I spoke directly with DHS staff about the need for de‑escalation tactics. What has happened since — including the serious injuries to protesters outside Delaney Hall and reports that detainees are being assaulted and pepper sprayed in

Delaney Hall is run by GEO Group under a 15-year, $1 billion contract. That’s not public safety. That’s a private corporation, giving $$$ to Tump's campaign and then getting rich off human suffering, all with a documented history of neglect and abuse.

We’re paying a corporation to warehouse our neighbors. The people inside Delaney Hall are overwhelmingly not charged with any crime. In my visit, I talked with people who have American families, children, and even grandchildren.

Cruelty isn’t str

The Trump DOJ is now erasing the truth about January 6th. Reports of violent assaults on police officers scrubbed away as 'partisan propaganda' while funneling billions into Trump’s billion dollar slush fund for his allies and possibly January 6 rioters. This gross misuse of taxpayer dollars is one of the most brazen acts of corruption in our history.

op: @npr

Video

The numbers on Trump’s corruption are staggering. Billions on vanity projects while families struggle to make ends meet.

This a betrayal of the public trust. We deserve better and . We must demand integrity, accountability, and a government that works for the people.

op: @sarahlongwell

Video

Bobby Collins—90 years young, Navy veteran, and janitor for 50 years at Tantasqua Regional High School—just got the surprise celebration he so richly deserves. 

May we recognize, celebrate and acknowledge each other more.

Video

“If I love you, I have to make you conscious of the things that you do not see.”
-James Baldwin

Video

I got some wise words from Rep. Clyburn today, who reminded me that the true way out of this nightmare is Americans going to the polls in massive numbers so that we regain control of Congress.

Video

Today I visited Delaney Hall as part of my congressional oversight duties, meeting with both those who run the facility and privately with people being held there.

After seeing who is being held and the conditions under which they’re detained, I believe most Americans would agree that this facility is a moral stain on our community.

In fact, the majority of the people we encountered have NO criminal charges or the kind of violence or criminality that Donald Trump said he was going to be focusi

The work of USAID showcased the best of us, demonstrated American leadership, and kept us safe.

The Trump administration’s budget cuts have severely undermined the global health programs designed to protect us from outbreaks like Ebola. This isn’t just shortsighted—it’s dangerous. We must restore America’s leadership before more lives are lost.

Video

I so appreciate the wisdom from this wonderful young person.

op: @recess_therapy

Video

I got some wise words from Rep. Clyburn today, who reminded me that the true way out of this nightmare is Americans going to the polls in massive numbers so that we regain control of Congress.

Video

Americans are losing healthcare because they can’t afford it, they’re struggling to pay the rent or mortgage, their prescription drugs, and then they look up and see a President focused on grifting not governing.

Video

In a world with too much indiscriminate meanness, I love this deliberate kindness. 

These family rules should be our rules too.

op: @natestone84

Video

No one is above the law, and corruption all too easily begets authoritarianism. We have to stand against it. 

op: @annaconnellyiscool

Video

Senator Padilla is absolutely right: the people who tried to overthrow our government and attacked police don’t deserve a taxpayer-funded payout. We’ll keep fighting to ensure this never happens.

op: @alexpadilla4ca

Video

How much is Trump’s reckless and unauthorized war costing Americans? The estimates are shocking:
$29 billion of our tax dollars that could have gone to working families healthcare, childcare, or education
$40 billion directly out of your wallet to pay for higher gas prices

op: @financialtimes

Video
Donald Trump isn’t governing, he is grifting.

George Floyd’s murder shook the conscience of our nation and the world. The collective pain inspired a powerful movement for justice and reform. We must keep pushing until we truly have equal justice for all.
